title: Per-subagent Viche identity: make Claude Code subagents first-class network members
design:
Investigated 2026-08-17. Decision: DEFERRED, not rejected. Do not build yet.

## Question
Can Claude Code subagents be first-class Viche participants with their own
agent IDs, instead of sharing the host session's single ID?

## Measured today
A spawned subagent called `viche_whoami` and got the IDENTICAL id and registry
as its parent. Subagents inherit the viche MCP tools and act on the network AS
the host, indistinguishably. Sender is stamped server-side from the socket
(lib/viche_web/channels/agent_channel.ex:124-128), so a real second identity
requires a real second connection - payload spoofing is impossible.

## Three blockers, ascending difficulty
1. Single global identity in the MCP process. `activeAgentId` is a module
   singleton (channel/claude-code-plugin-viche/service.ts:68), set once on join
   (:261-266), read context-free by every tool (:360, tools.ts:517-525).
   Fix: keyed map of connections. Mechanical.
2. No caller discriminator. MCP CallToolRequest carries no subagent/session id
   and no tool schema accepts name/as/from, so even with N connections the
   server cannot tell which subagent is calling. Fix: explicit identity
   tool-arg, or one MCP server instance per subagent.
3. Inbound routing is pipe-scoped, not identity-scoped. `new_message` becomes a
   `notifications/claude/channel` MCP notification (service.ts:233-257)
   delivered to whoever owns the stdio pipe. One inbox -> one session.
   THIS IS A CLAUDE CODE LIMITATION, NOT A VICHE ONE. Solving 1+2 buys
   per-subagent SENDING but not RECEIVING. Subagents also cannot be woken by
   external events - only a tool round or SendMessage.

## Server side is mostly ready
- No rate limit or per-caller registration cap on the registration path
  (lib/viche_web/controllers/registry_controller.ex:16-102 ->
  lib/viche/agents.ex:186-193); auth optional and never halts
  (lib/viche_web/plugs/api_auth.ex:33-53). N identities per host already legal.
- Identities SELF-EXPIRE: polling_timeout_ms (lib/viche/agent_server.ex:137,
  252-264) and grace_period_ms (:229-243, :299-301); restart: :temporary
  (:37-43); GenServer-memory-only state (:124-135). Ephemeral subagent
  identities would NOT leak.
- ABSENT: no parent_id/spawner linkage (lib/viche/agent.ex:11-23,
  lib/viche/agents/agent_record.ex:18-44), no generic metadata field, no bulk
  registration. Registries are a flat registries: [String.t()] list =
  namespace, not hierarchy. So a subagent fleet would appear as N unrelated
  peers; discovery could not express "that orchestrator's workers".

## Verdict
| Layer | State |
|---|---|
| Server identity + lifecycle | Ready as-is |
| Server hierarchy/provenance | Missing - needs parent_id or metadata |
| Client outbound | Buildable, modest |
| Inbound to a subagent | Blocked by Claude Code |

Achievable shape today: distinct identity + own outbox, inbox RELAYED through
the orchestrator. Subagents become real, discoverable, individually-addressable
members whose mail the orchestrator hands them.

## Scope if picked up
- Plugin: singleton -> keyed connection map; identity as explicit tool arg.
- Server: add parent_id (or generic metadata) for fleet provenance.
- Out of scope until Claude Code changes: true per-subagent inbound.

## Related
- stash@{0} on feat/message-correlation-threading: "add in_reply_to and
  conversation_id to all three channel plugins" - the correlation primitive a
  relay design needs. UNMERGED.
- No prior decision exists. Closest: Open Question #1 in
  thoughts/research/2026-03-24-openclaw-viche-integration.md leaned "probably
  yes" but scoped to OpenClaw's gateway, never revisited for Claude Code.
- Full server-side research w/ citations:
  ~/Projects/pantheon-pi/thoughts/research/2026-08-17-viche-identity-registry-multi-subagent.md
- STALE, do not trust: thoughts/research/2026-03-24-agent-lifecycle.md claims
  8-char hex ids and no cleanup. Both superseded - ids are UUIDs, self-expiry
  exists.
